topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the overarching lecture themes regarding cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how successive driver mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how normal tissue hierarchies, cell-of-origin characteristics, and cancer stem cell properties influence tumor initiation and progression across different tissues.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Stromal Interactions, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments drive tumor initiation and progression, how these interactions are investigated, and how genetic and environmental factors coevolve.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
